author: /root/transport_fallback
disposition: faithful_port for the observable assertions of NodeTest.ClassMemberCallbackMessage and NodeTest.ClassMemberCallbackMessageInfo; the native callback registration API, object pointer identity and scheduling are not claimed

independent.raw_export: Exact index tree exported to reviewer-owned private source and exclusive Cargo target; both source hashes reproduced.
independent.native_originals: Both pinned NodeTest originals passed 2/0 with exact source and binary hashes.
independent.rust: All three private Rust tests passed 3/0 after local socket access; first sandbox run failed EPERM at setup and is excluded.
independent.mutant: Changing only the Info dispatcher call from cb_info to cb makes the exact original Info test fail its complete topic/partition/type/intra_process observation; no production source changed.

assertion_mapping: Invalid Subscribe and two invalid Advertise attempts map to InvalidName; successful subscription and Publisher construction map native true/Valid; has_connections maps native HasConnections. The owned asynchronous MemberClient method receives Int32 data 5; Info case checks exact /foo, canonical partition, gz.msgs.Int32 and intra_process true. The original 100 ms settle remains. The original-path Publisher is destroyed at SendSomeData return before the callback wait, matching native; exact-once and checked owner retirement are additional controls.
limits: This is a test-only adaptation with no public callback registration API or production changes. It does not establish native callback scheduling or C++ object-pointer semantics, broader NET-02 closure, or latency. V1 lacked SPDX and V2 retained the Publisher through callback; both are superseded. Their positive gates are excluded from this decision. Final metadata, normal hook, public commit and hosted qualification remain pending.
